title: JANUS UAP Domain Index — 2026-08-14
purpose: Provide a discoverable read map for the JANUS UAP, nuclear-context and POSS-I transient research lineage without rewriting historical artifacts or promoting an open corrective audit to canonical authority.

authority_boundary.reason: The newest POSS-I baseline/trigger and plate-day Phase-0 artifacts remain OPEN/reproducibility-level. Navigation may point to them as active research heads without promoting them to admitted canonical authority.

POSS1_TRANSIENTS_NUCLEAR_UAP_CORRELATION.core_question: Do POSS-I candidate transients contain a validated non-nuclear baseline plus a residual nuclear or broader ionization/geomagnetic modulation after exposure, schedule and plate-artifact controls?

LEGACY_UAP_META.important_note: Legacy confidence labels and Galileo/AARO wording must be read through the 2026 corrective audit; unresolved and ambiguous observations are not automatically anomalous.

CONUS_NUCLEAR_SITE_UAP_SPATIAL_ANALYSIS.required_next_control: Recode provenance and outcome semantics so OBSERVATION_VERIFIED, IDENTITY_RESOLVED, KINEMATICS_VALIDATED, ANOMALOUS_PERFORMANCE_VALIDATED and ORIGIN_VALIDATED are distinct.

REPRODUCIBILITY_AND_SOURCE_FREEZE.blocker: Exact 107,875-source/635-plate VASCO catalog and 2,718-day master are request-only; the 13-record source-vs-daily count difference, plate provenance, and 124-vs-126 nuclear calendar definition must be reconciled before beta_nuclear is admitted.

NUCLEAR_UAP_EMULATION_AND_NULLS.role: Synthetic pseudo-event and false-positive controls; simulation outputs cannot establish real-world UAP or nuclear causation by themselves.

CROSS_DOMAIN_COSMOLOGY_AND_FALLOUT_ANALO.hard_boundary: UAP/nuclear correlations may inform an observational layer but cannot be upgraded into proof of Many-Worlds branching, new classical universes, Fallout doctrine, or non-human agency.

next_read_order_for_execution: 1. Read the non-nuclear baseline/trigger corrective audit.
2. Read the plate-day Phase-0 acquisition gate and satisfy G0-G3 without inspecting target beta_nuclear.
3. Run the fail-closed input validator and freeze raw SHA-256 plus explicit column mappings.
4. Build the 635-plate-bound plate-day exposure matrix; keep full STScI survey exposure as a separate sensitivity layer.
5. Execute preregistered NB2 H0-vs-H1 plus mandatory sensitivity analyses.
6. Only after reproduction, issue a new admitted authority artifact or leave the domain OPEN/REFUTED as the results require.
integrity_rules: This file is navigation, not evidence.
Historical JSONs remain byte/provenance records and are not silently rewritten by this index.
A corrective artifact can supersede an interpretation without deleting the historical artifact that produced it.
A public non-equivalent catalog may be a control but may not silently replace the exact target catalog.
Any future current-authority pointer must target an explicitly admitted canonical artifact, not merely the most recent research head.
